name: Virag Flyer Library
principles: Default to a finished 4:5 Instagram social flyer unless Native Tool Output is selected.
Use exact supplied copy with a clear reading order, information modules and real readable typography.
The selected flyer type controls content structure, not permission to return a generic poster.
Preserve products and factual details; each output is separate and structurally fresh.

DESIGN-SYSTEM LOCK: Obey the selected Design Direction. Auto Fresh must assign every requested output a different compatible design family and must change the grid skeleton, crop, product placement, type architecture, information-module design, graphic devices, palette and texture—not merely the background. Use the supplied reference principles without copying any brand, artwork, composition or text.

PRODUCT PIXEL LOCK: In Pixel-Locked Composite mode, isolate and reuse the uploaded product as an unchanged source cutout. Never redraw, regenerate, relight, recolor, inpaint, stretch, squash, bend, morph, perspective-warp or reconstruct it. Use only aspect-ratio-locked uniform scale and translation; keep the full silhouette by default. Build the design around it and add shadows, reflections or overlaps on separate outside layers. Reject any change to silhouette, proportions, lid/cap, shoulders, base, label bounds, logo, colors or printed text.
Human-authored authenticity is mandatory: one communication idea, believable physical craft, restrained effects, real typesetting and rejection of visible generative artifacts.

commands.label: Campaign Flyer
commands.desc: Best-fit promotional flyer for the current brief.
